0.original: Maru wants YOU to promote the Hippo Riders.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

48.original: I promised the boss I'd try an' get the cart rollin', but lazin' about here ain't exactly goin' to make a job of it...

49.original: It ain't much, but I tried makin' some handbills... You think you could pass 'em out around Yedlihmad?

50.original: Tell folks that if they bring back one of these, they'll get a discount. That sounds professional, right? Anyhow, I'll leave the talkin' to you─I know you'll explain it good.

52.original: A start-up delivery service...by hippo cart? And here I thought chocobo carriages were the only viable option. What an intriguing angle.

53.original: I only off-load luggage, so delivery arrangements are out of my hands, but I'll take this to my friends at the harbor guild. They may yet find some use for it.

54.original: Oh, the Hippo Riders! Yes, my friend at the harbor guild tried them straightaway. Wouldn't stop gushing about their speedy carts.

55.original: If you could spare a few more handbills, I know of some others who will appreciate that discount!

56.original: I'll be sure to pass this along.

58.original: A delivery service! By hippo cart, no less. This is perfect timing─it just so happens that I need a parcel delivered to the Giantsgall Grounds without delay.

59.original: “Fastest on the island,” are they? I shall certainly put them to the test! Thank you, I'll head over straightaway.

60.original: Those speedy Hippo Riders! No false advertising there─they had my package to its recipient in no time at all. Count me a satisfied customer!

61.original: I daresay it's time to redeem my second discount. I wonder if I could persuade them into a fixed contract...

63.original: Oh! The Hippo Riders! I know a fellow who works there!

64.original: Nothing would make me happier than supporting an Arkasodara-run business like this. I simply must find something for them to deliver!

65.original: Out promoting the Hippo Riders again? I found something to deliver, and they had it in Radz-at-Han in no time at all─and at a discount!

66.original: Of course, I'll be needing it shipped back now, so could I trouble you for another handbill? Oh, and some extras for my friends!

67.original: Handed out the handbills, have you?

68.original: I'm glad we piqued some interest. Handin' out adverts ain't glamorous, but it sure gets the job done...

69.original: I'll keep thinkin' up new ways of gettin' our name out there. Come by again when you've got the time...
